feedback.problem:
Find the missing values in the following truth table:

| $\,A\,$ | $\,B\,$ | $\,¬(A∨¬B)∧¬A\,$ | $\,A∧(B∧¬A)\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | {{field-1}} | $\text{F}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | {{field-2}} | $\text{F}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | {{field-3}} |

Using your results, complete the following statement:

$$
¬(A∨¬B)∧¬A{{field-4}}A∧(B∧¬A)
$$
feedback.worked_solution:
First, let's solve for the missing values:

- When $A≡\text{T}$ and $B≡\text{F},$ we have

$$
\begin{aligned}¬(A∨¬B)∧¬A & ≡¬(\text{T}∨¬\text{F})∧¬\text{T} \\  & ≡¬(\text{T}∨\text{T})∧\text{F} \\  & ≡¬\text{T}∧\text{F} \\  & ≡\text{F}∧\text{F} \\  & ≡\text{F}\end{aligned}
$$

- When $A≡\text{F}$ and $B≡\text{T},$ we have

$$
\begin{aligned}¬(A∨¬B)∧¬A & ≡¬(\text{F}∨¬\text{T})∧¬\text{F} \\  & ≡¬(\text{F}∨\text{F})∧\text{T} \\  & ≡¬\text{F}∧\text{T} \\  & ≡\text{T}∧\text{T} \\  & ≡\text{T}\end{aligned}
$$

- When $A≡\text{F}$ and $B≡\text{F},$ we have

$$
\begin{aligned}A∧(B∧¬A) & ≡\text{F}∧(\text{F}∧¬\text{F}) \\  & ≡\text{F}∧(\text{F}∧\text{T}) \\  & ≡\text{F}∧\text{F} \\  & ≡\text{F}\end{aligned}
$$

Our completed table is shown below.

| $\,A\,$ | $\,B\,$ | $\,¬(A∨¬B)∧¬A\,$ | $\,A∧(B∧¬A)\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ |

To determine whether $¬(A∨¬B)∧¬A$ is logically equivalent to $A∧(B∧¬A),$ we need to check whether their truth tables are equivalent.

Looking at the last two columns, we see that they differ in the third row. Therefore, we conclude that 

$$
¬(A∨¬B)∧¬A≢A∧(B∧¬A).
$$
